sources.name: 24 Gentle Steps to Christmas — old English paperback
strengths: Happy Makers names and legacy character identities
Existing English front matter and December framing
weaknesses: Mindfulness/coaching language is much heavier than the current quality target
Many games are mechanically weaker or repetitive
Day 9 Human Knot and Day 24 singing-only finale were superseded in PL R4
English voice often reads like translated/inspirational workbook copy rather than modern premium family writing

sources.name: Gentle Steps PL V3 R4 Final Content Candidate
strengths: Natural family reality and anti-cringe tone

convergence_rule: Use PL R4 as functional/product master. Preserve legacy EN only when it is clearly stronger or supplies unique brand/front-matter value. Never downgrade PL R4 to match old EN.
